canonical.title: A weekend at Le Coquillage: where to sleep, what to do, what's bookable

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Le Coquillage
siblings.summary: Where to sleep within walking distance of Hugo Roellinger's three-star Le Coquillage at Château Richeux — six options inside a 1 km radius, ranked by price and proximity.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Le Coquillage
siblings.summary: Eleven hotels and chambres d'hôtes between on-site at Château Richeux and a 30-minute taxi ride away — sorted by what kind of weekend you're actually planning.

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Le Coquillage
siblings.summary: What to do in the 30-km circle around the Roellinger family's three-star Le Coquillage — Saint-Malo's ramparts, Cancale's oyster market, Dinard's Belle Époque, Mont-Saint-Michel and the inland heritage triangle.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Le Coquillage
siblings.summary: Saint-Malo (9 km from Le Coquillage) is the only nearby IT-conference hub. 2026 calendar is bunched April–May — CPS-IoT Week, PQCrypto, Trois Océans. Next upcoming: Digital Benchmark in September.

sources.title: Le Coquillage — Ille-et-Vilaine Tourisme
sources.claim: Le Coquillage opening hours — Tuesday through Saturday, 12h–14h and 19h–23h30, closed Sunday and Monday.

sources.title: Le Coquillage — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Le Coquillage restaurant address and core booking info — at Château Richeux, Le Buot, 35350 Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes; phone +33 2 99 89 64 76.

sources.title: Ferme du Vent — Le Fooding
sources.claim: Ferme du Vent rates — €275 first night then €200 subsequent; package incl. 2 meals/2 breakfasts at €590; 5 'kled' gîtes.

sources.title: Taxis Saint-Malo — tarifs
sources.claim: Saint-Malo taxis apply a night surcharge (tarif B / nuit) from 19:00 to 07:00, raising the per-km rate ~50%.

sources.title: Grain de Vanille — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Grain de Vanille, the family's pastry shop-tea room at 12 place de la Victoire in upper Cancale, opens 9am-6:30pm continuously, closed Tuesdays.

sources.title: Mont-Saint-Michel high tides — Normandie Tourisme
sources.claim: A coefficient of about 110 is required for the sea to fully surround the Mount and flood the causeway, turning it back into an island.

sources.title: Mont-Saint-Michel tide schedule
sources.claim: April 18, 2026 is the highest spring tide of the year at the Mont with coefficient 105.

sources.title: CPS-IoT Week 2026
sources.claim: CPS-IoT Week 2026 — 19th edition — takes place 11–14 May 2026 in Saint-Malo.

sources.title: PQCrypto 2026
sources.claim: PQCrypto 2026 — 17th International Conference on Post-Quantum Cryptography — took place 14–16 April 2026 in Saint-Malo.

sources.title: Digital Benchmark 2026
sources.claim: Digital Benchmark 2026 — runs 28–29 September 2026 in Saint-Malo: ~300 CMOs/CDOs, organised by EBG.

sources.title: Château Richeux — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Château Richeux 2026 availability windows.

sources.title: Château Richeux — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Château Richeux is 5 km from Cancale on the D155 toward Mont-Saint-Michel; 12-room Relais & Châteaux with on-site Le Coquillage.

sources.title: La Ferme du Vent — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Five kled lodges in Breton wood and stone, 400–500 m through gardens from Château Richeux.

sources.title: Les Rimains — Maisons de Bricourt
sources.claim: Les Rimains is at 62 rue des Rimains, 35260 Cancale — four sea-facing rooms perched on the Cancale cliffs.

sources.title: Hôtel Elizabeth Saint-Malo
sources.claim: Hôtel Elizabeth, built in 1600, is the oldest dated building inside Saint-Malo's walls.

sources.title: Castelbrac Dinard
sources.claim: Castelbrac occupies a 1930s cliff-edge villa in Dinard with 25 sea-facing rooms over Prieuré bay.

sources.title: Épices Roellinger
sources.claim: Épices Roellinger's Cancale shop sits inside the Maison du Voyageur at 1 rue Duguesclin.

sources.title: Maisons de Bricourt — Places
sources.claim: The Maisons de Bricourt portfolio in Cancale also includes Le Bistrot de Cancale and La Cuisine Corsaire École.

sources.title: Le Coquillage — MICHELIN Guide
sources.claim: Le Coquillage holds 3 Michelin stars (2025/2026) under Hugo Roellinger.

sources.title: Le Coquillage — Relais & Châteaux
sources.claim: Le Coquillage is the in-house fine-dining restaurant of the Château Richeux property within the Relais & Châteaux network.

sources.title: La Ferme du Vent — Cancale Tourisme
sources.claim: Ferme du Vent is 400–500 m on foot from Château Richeux and shares the same gardens.

sources.title: Le Manoir des Douets Fleuris
sources.claim: 17th-century granite manor in Cancale once owned by a French East India Company merchant-weaver family.

sources.title: Maison Tirel-Guérin / Domaine du Limonay
sources.claim: 4-star country estate in Saint-Méloir-des-Ondes dating to 1936, with covered heated pool, sauna and tennis.

sources.title: Le Grand Hôtel des Thermes
sources.claim: Belle Époque hotel from 1881 facing Sillon beach, with 177 rooms and one of France's most established marine thalassotherapy spas.

sources.title: Hôtel Le Nautilus Saint-Malo
sources.claim: 17th-century building inside the walls of Saint-Malo, fully renovated in 2025 with 15 soundproofed rooms.

sources.title: Hôtel Le Grand Bé
sources.claim: 4-star intra-muros hotel with 55 rooms, 50 m from Bon Secours beach; spa in 17th-century vaulted cellars.

sources.title: Château Hôtel du Colombier
sources.claim: 1715 malouinière built by a Compagnie des Indes ship owner, set in a 6-hectare park.

sources.title: Marché aux Huîtres de Cancale
sources.claim: Cancale's oyster market operates daily with 8 independent producers; spring/summer hours 9am-7pm.

sources.title: Marché aux Huîtres — Cancale Tourisme
sources.claim: A dozen huîtres creuses at the Cancale market costs roughly 6-10€.

sources.title: Saint-Malo ramparts walk
sources.claim: Saint-Malo ramparts form a free walking loop of about 2 km taking roughly 1 hour.

sources.title: Fort National Saint-Malo
sources.claim: Fort National admission is €5 adult and €3 child; tide-dependent access on foot from Plage de l'Éventail.

sources.title: Pointe du Grouin — Cancale Tourisme
sources.claim: Pointe du Grouin offers panoramas of Mont-Saint-Michel on clear days, hosts WWII blockhouses near the semaphore.

sources.title: Grand Aquarium Saint-Malo
sources.claim: Grand Aquarium at Avenue du Général Patton in the La Madeleine district about 6 km south of intra-muros.

sources.title: Plage de Bon-Secours
sources.claim: Plage de Bon-Secours has a 1937 tidal seawater swimming pool with diving board, refilled twice daily.

sources.title: Mont-Saint-Michel Abbey
sources.claim: Mont-Saint-Michel Abbey 2026 entry is €16 from 1 April–30 September and €13 from 1 October–31 March.

sources.title: Compagnie Corsaire — Saint-Malo ↔ Dinard sea-bus
sources.claim: Saint-Malo ↔ Dinard sea-bus crosses the estuary in ~10 minutes.

sources.title: RTAS 2026
sources.claim: RTAS 2026 — 32nd IEEE Real-Time and Embedded Technology and Applications Symposium — runs 12–14 May 2026 in Saint-Malo.

sources.title: SenSys 2026
sources.claim: SenSys 2026 is the ACM/IEEE International Conference on Embedded Artificial Intelligence and Sensing Systems.

sources.title: HSCC/ICCPS 2026
sources.claim: HSCC/ICCPS 2026 runs 11–14 May 2026 in Saint-Malo.
